permissions.source_valid_labels: existing sourcevalid only: calculate15 view NLL reliability weights, immutable v10 temperatures; terminal metrics; no new model/threshold selection
permissions.source_valid_inputs: per seed/slice frozen v9 margin mean/SD and evidence mean/SD over all2160 valid rows; no query fit
permissions.reference: not needed and not loaded this run
permissions.query: cached logits only, per-sample fixed score; labels terminal pAUC/frontier/error taxonomy; no fitting/selecting scores or parameters
permissions.model: all existing cached logits/checkpoint predictions read-only, no new training or inference
permissions.label_identity: inherited content_supported102class assumption, not official mapping

fusion.logodds: (view_logit(candidate)-view_logit(frozen_class))/immutable_sourcevalid_temperature; algebraically equal log probability ratio without probability clipping
fusion.equal: mean over15 correlated seed/views, not sum
fusion.weights: exp(-NLL_sourcevalid) normalized across all15, fixed using sourcevalid labels only
fusion.variance: weighted variance of logodds across15; soft=weighted_mean-.25*weighted_sd
fusion.scale: sourcevalid full-row mean and population SD; denominator max(SD,.001); fit separately perseed/slice margin and each evidence scalar
fusion.shuffled: preserve v9 margin, shuffle auxiliary soft z only within changed candidates by deterministic row hash; preserve evidence multiset, no labels
fusion.interpretation: source-reliability-weighted log support, not an independent-evidence likelihood or calibrated Bayesian damage posterior; no sigmoid saturation, GMM risk or quantile envelope

metrics.primary: partial ROC area FPR<=.01 with all frozen-correct samples as negatives; positives successful fixed-v9 correction candidates only; other-wrong excluded from ROC but explicitly tracked
metrics.fpr_denominator: all frozen correct, so FP/N_frozen_correct=NAR, unchanged negatives score sentinel below changed scores for ROC audit
metrics.pauc: raw trapezoid area and raw/alpha (mean correction-candidate TPR over low-NAR interval); no McClish .5 standardization
metrics.operational: mean Recovery under NAR budget0..1% with deterministic unique-score thresholds, left-step area/alpha; no fractional tie acceptance
metrics.note: partial ROC TPR uses fixed correctable candidate count, Recovery uses all frozen errors; factor=oracle Recovery. Previously conditional damage-only ROC FPR is not NAR. Query-label-selected thresholds diagnostic only, not deployable. No globalAUROC selection.

gates.primary: BOTH slices: primary normalized_pAUC improves>=.01 over v9_margin; Recovery@NAR1 improves>=.2pp; step meanRecovery not worse; invalid_other_per_correction not worse. Allseed outcomes report. No candidate changes or automatic integration.
gates.control: report primary vs v11_min, soft-only vs mean, blend/no-variance, shuffled evidence; no relabeling best secondary as primary
gates.stop: one frozen batch, no target-feedback changes or score search; if fail retain v9 original scorer

budget.stop: no hyperparameter grid, no extra slices, documented same-config implementation repairs only
